known_limitations: Uses deterministic pseudo-basemap for self-contained validation, not Leaflet tiles.
Offline expensive reference, not production implementation.
If visual drift from 2.41d is observed, adjust sampling/compositing only; transfer LUT remains locked.
rendering_method: Offline Python/PIL/numpy supersampled render. Samples locked 2.41d RGB transfer as LUT and applies it proportionally across dense centerline-to-left/right boundary samples. Exact projected polygon-domain mask is applied before and after smoothing/downsampling to prevent rectangular sampling footprints.
scope: validation-only geometry reintegration using locked transfer

strict_audit.residual_artifacts: Faint horizontal endpoint edges may still be visible in the offline pseudo-basemap context; these are coverage/masking artifacts, not transfer drift.
strict_audit.smallest_next_correction: If residual artifacts remain, keep 2.41d LUT locked and further refine polygon coverage/sampling density/edge antialiasing only.
strict_audit.visible_strip_decomposition: improved by masking; requires human visual QA for residual endpoint-edge artifacts
